newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE defence minister condemns Israel.
newsitem.headline: UAE defence minister condemns Israel.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates Defence Minister condemned Israel's "violent acts" against Palestinians and urged the Jewish state to honour agreements reached in the Middle East peace process.

In an interview with the Lebanese newspaper al-Anwar carried by the official WAM news agency on Sunday ahead of publication, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid al-Maktoum warned Israel that "any setback to the peace process could be counterproductive and might irreparably damage peace as a whole."
"The solution is now in the hands of Israel," he said, urging the Jewish state "to change its current policies and revoke all decisions that are counter to peace agreements."

The UAE has expressed concern about the clashes between Israeli and Palestinian forces that erupted on Wednesday over Israel's decision to open a tunnel in Jerusalem's Old City near al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest shrine.
At least 55 Palestinians and 14 Israelis have been killed in the clashes.
